disposition_reason: Figure 4F supplies an ordered missed/false-event comparison, but its numeric DUNL point, exact original split and complete source-to-file cohort join are not recovered. The current release makes the programmed target schedule explicit; hiding it or replacing this with held-response prediction would change the task. The existing coupled reconstruction grader cannot establish an event-detection paper win.

target.description: Infer whisker manipulation event onsets from single-trial VPm spikes; Figure 4F compares missed and false events. Shared-kernel reconstruction is a separate output.

dataset.description: Paper-associated Mendeley release rzfyr2886h version 1 is identified, but its exact whisker assay file roster and checksums are unjoined.

cohort.description: Figure 4 shows ten neurons. The pinned preprocessor selects ten neuron pairs while allocating eleven channels; original eligibility, animal/session identities and the zero channel require reconciliation.

split.description: Current preprocessing concatenates original train/test arrays and takes first 30 of 50 trials for training. Its equivalence to the publication split and trial identities has not been authenticated.

inputs.description: Single-trial spikes and the disclosed stimulation protocol. Source code generates targets at floor((500+125*k)/5), k=0,...,15; that public schedule must remain equally available.

preprocessing.description: Pinned code bins 1 ms samples into 5 ms normalized sums and estimates logit baseline from the first 500 ms with a 0.001 floor. Exact publication configuration remains unresolved.

metric.description: Current code binarizes positive predictions, marks target neighborhoods within two bins, and computes hit-count/target-count and outside-neighborhood-prediction-count/prediction-count. Miss=1-min(mean_hit,1). Multi-matches count; this is not one-to-one recall or F1. Publication-to-code parity remains unverified.

aggregation.description: compute_hit_rate averages row-level hit and false fractions, after summing kernel/time axes; the plot clips the mean hit to one. Authentic trial/neuron reshaping and the Figure 4F producer remain unjoined.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 4F missed-event fraction and false-event fraction at 10 ms tolerance (joint endpoint)

published_baseline.description: The numeric Figure 4F point was not recovered. Nearby published R-squared values 0.1612 (16 events) and 0.1766 (18 events) assess reconstruction and cannot be substituted for this event endpoint.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No full-cohort author event baseline was executed or authenticated; source code supplies a route only after split, exporter and configuration joins.

minimum_effect.rationale: A scalar margin cannot be assigned to an unrecovered two-dimensional operating point. Prespecify meaningful dominance or a source-compatible fixed-operating-point comparison after recovering the paper values; no arbitrary scalarization.

uncertainty.method: Prespecify paired uncertainty for the complete original trial/cohort comparison after identifying independent recording groups.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Unresolved animal/recording groups, with trials nested; events and time bins are not independent biological replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: The code reports means, not valid biological uncertainty; unknown acquisition dependence prevents choosing a defensible resampling unit.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact Figure 4F DUNL operating point and reproduce it from the publication-aligned author route on every original eligible case.
Keep the original target, inputs, split, 10 ms neighborhood convention and aggregation; a new split, one-to-one metric, hidden schedule or response-prediction task is a separately labelled extension.
Freeze the selected method and operating point using permitted training/development feedback before a single protected final comparison under declared access and resource budgets.
Demonstrate a justified improvement in the predeclared joint miss/false comparison with appropriate uncertainty; matching the paper or reducing local reconstruction loss is insufficient.
Include the disclosed schedule-only control; algebraic recovery of programmed labels alone is not an observed full-cohort paper win or evidence of neural understanding.

current_sota.description: Only source-paper comparison is scoped; no current SOTA was reviewed or claimed.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source recovery. If admitted, iterate on original training trials and a declared development policy; do not use final paper test scores for selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, weights, threshold/operating point, code and data/configuration identities before final event scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Run complete publication-aligned test cases once, report both original event fractions and author baseline; disclose public schedule assistance and retain reconstruction as a secondary calibration output.
episode.baseline_policy: The paper point, reproduced author point and schedule-only control are separate. No invented score, current-code rerun, local grader tolerance or corrected split silently replaces the published baseline.

blocking_issues: Numeric Figure 4F operating point and its source result artifact are not recovered.
Publication trial split/configuration and exact source output producer are unjoined.
Complete archive file manifest, ten-neuron/eleven-channel reconciliation and animal/session map remain unresolved.
The programmed labels are publicly deterministic; any admissible event improvement must disclose this limitation.
Meaningful joint effect, independent-unit uncertainty, concrete budgets and an authenticated full event evaluator are not established.

legacy.notes: Retain historical event auditing and coupled decoder/response loss as calibration components. Neither engineering parity nor a mathematically perfect public schedule establishes a measured scientific improvement.
